shots.desc: Bare canvas paints itself into Privet Drive at midnight. Dumbledore and McGonagall wait beneath a glowing streetlamp under a swirling sky.
Hagrid, enormous and gentle, walks in carrying a tiny bundle and offers it to Dumbledore.
Close on baby Harry in his blanket; the lightning scar glimmers. The stars spiral into the next scene.
Time-lapse over Number Four: sun and moon wheel across the sky, the tree turns through the seasons.
Inside: the Dursleys glow smugly around their table while Harry sits alone in the cold blue cupboard under the stairs.
A white owl glides to the windowsill; a golden letter drops through the door onto the mat. Harry picks it up.
Hundreds of golden envelopes burst from the fireplace and swirl through the room. Vernon flails; Harry leaps, delighted.
The camera follows a single letter out into a stormy night sky, toward a hut on a rock in the sea.
Lightning illuminates the lonely hut on its rock; waves crash. A giant silhouette stands at the door.
The door bursts open. Hagrid fills the doorway of the drab brown hut. Harry looks up, astonished. Hagrid speaks.
Close on Harry as the fire flares: muted browns bloom into luminous blues and golds. He smiles for the first time.
A sweeping move down Diagon Alley: swinging signs, floating books, owls, lanterns, crooked glowing shopfronts. Harry and Hagrid walk in.
In the wand shop Harry raises a wand; golden light spirals out and lifts his hair.
A scarlet engine emerges from billowing clouds of blue pigment steam.
The Hogwarts Express races through golden wheat hills and dark cypresses under a rolling daylight sky.
Train compartment. Ron sits down opposite Harry and offers a sweet. Hermione appears in the doorway, brisk and curious.
Lantern-lit boats cross the black lake; lights ripple in the water. The three children look up.
The reveal: Hogwarts, an enormous painted castle of glowing windows beneath a living Starry Night sky. The showpiece shot.
McGonagall, composed, welcomes the first-years at the top of the stairs beneath floating candles.
Charms class: Hermione's feather rises on a ribbon of gold. Ron stares glumly. Hermione speaks.
Harry and Ron laugh together by the common-room fire.
Draco, flanked by two hulking shapes, steps up to Harry with a sneer. Harry stands his ground.
Snape watches from the shadows, cloak stirring, eyes fixed on Harry.
Harry on a broom streaks across the sky after a tiny golden ball; the brushstroke sky streams past.
A monstrous troll shadow looms over Hermione; Harry and Ron rush in. The shadow falls, and three friends stand together.
The forbidden corridor: the trio creep through torchlit darkness toward a heavy door.
Three enormous dog heads rise out of the dark, eyes burning, one paw resting on a trapdoor. The children recoil.
In the library, a book glows with a painted crimson stone. Curiosity on three faces curdles into fear.
Snape sweeps down a moonlit corridor, his shadow stretching huge across the wall, while timid Quirrell shrinks aside. Harry speaks over it.
The trapdoor: the trio drop into darkness, robes streaming.
Tangling vines coil around them; Hermione's wand flares blue-white and the vines recoil.
A glittering storm of winged keys; Harry on a broom snatches the right one.
A gigantic chessboard with towering stone pieces. Ron rides the knight; pieces grind forward.
Ron speaks, then the white queen strikes. Ron falls. Harry and Hermione cry out.
Hermione kneels by Ron and urges Harry on. Harry walks alone through a wall of dark flames.
The last chamber. A figure before a tall mirror turns around: not Snape, but Quirrell, suddenly calm and cold.
The turban unwinds into ribbons of paint; a pale spectral face with burning eyes forms in green shadow. Voldemort speaks.
Shadow lunges at Harry. Golden light, shaped like a mother's embrace, erupts from him; the darkness cracks and dissolves into gold.
Warm morning light. Ron and Hermione run to Harry and embrace him; Dumbledore watches, smiling.
The camera pulls back from Hogwarts until the whole film is a framed living oil painting on a studio wall. Title card.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Beneath a restless sky, a child was left on a doorstep, with a scar... and a destiny.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For ten years, he lived unloved and unseen.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the letters came. One... a hundred... a storm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On his eleventh birthday, the truth broke down the door.

lines.speaker: HAGRID
lines.text: There's magic in yeh, Harry. Always has been.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And a grey world burst into colour.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A hidden street.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A wand that chose him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And a scarlet train, bound for somewhere he might belong.

lines.speaker: RON
lines.text: I'm Ron. Want a chocolate frog?

lines.speaker: HERMIONE
lines.text: I'm Hermione. I've read every book already!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then, across the dark water, it rose to meet them.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Hogwarts.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here, he found magic.

lines.speaker: HERMIONE
lines.text: See? Just like the book says.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A friend.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A rival.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And a shadow, always watching.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And when danger came, three strangers became inseparable.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the castle kept a secret.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A forbidden door... a monstrous guardian...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ...and a stone that could conquer death.

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.text: Someone's going to steal it. Tonight.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So down they went.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Through grasping vines...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ...a storm of winged keys...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ...and a chessboard built for giants.

lines.speaker: RON
lines.text: Go on, Harry. This move is mine.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The last door, he faced alone.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But it was not the shadow who waited there.

lines.speaker: VOLDEMORT
lines.text: At last... the Stone is mine.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the boy carried a magic no darkness could touch: a mother's love.

lines.speaker: DUMBLEDORE
lines.text: You were never alone, Harry.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And at last, the boy who lived was home.

music.direction: Mysterious and restrained. Sparse plucked figure over a low sustained string pad; a first hint of the main theme.
Lonely solo line, then a pulsing figure that multiplies as the letters multiply; swell into the storm.
Low tremolo tension and timpani rolls; hold breath when the door opens.
Warm major release as the room turns to colour.
Bright and curious: light plucked ostinato, playful woodwind-like lead, then an accelerating train rhythm from 38.0.
Gentle, friendly, smaller instrumentation; settle to near-silence on the lake.
Grand and wondrous: the full main theme, wide strings, horn-like brass, choir-like pad. The musical peak of the first half.
Playful montage; brief dark stabs at 62.2 (rival) and 64.4 (shadow); soaring lift 66.2-68.6 (flight); a heavy hit at 68.7 (troll) resolving warmly by 70.2.
Tense and foreboding: low drones, a slow chromatic motif, heartbeat-like pulse; swell under the dog at 75.6.
Driving ostinato and percussion; big impact at 97.7 followed by a hushed lament 98.4-100.0; then a rising line to 102.0.
Eerie: dissonant high cluster over sub-bass; grows powerful and dramatic 108.4-110.6.
Golden burst: full major statement of the main theme at 110.6.
Warm and hopeful resolution; final cadence lands at 117.6 and rings out to 120.0.
